note: Typical sizes and friction coefficients used only when the question does not state them. Every scene receipt names which values were defaults. Not outcomes: outcomes come from the solver.

sources.friction: Engineering ToolBox, Friction and Friction Coefficients, https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/friction-coefficients-d_778.html (mid-range of the listed static coefficients; table = plastic or glass on finished wood, ~0.2-0.3)
sources.sizes: typical consumer-object dimensions (500 mL PET bottle ~ 0.22 m x 0.065 m, ~0.5 kg filled; FIFA size-5 ball r 0.11 m, 0.43 kg); approximate, labelled default in every receipt

push.note: FORGE push convention: a steady horizontal force at the stated point, 1.25 x the smallest force that would start the body moving on the reference table either way (static friction mu_table m g, or tipping about the front edge m g w/2 / h), so the same push is applied on every surface, for 0.5 s; stated in every receipt. The solver decides which way it moves.
